title: Learning log added to packs
details: Each evidence-pack download now includes one PDF containing only the OTJ or GLH learning added since the previous pack download
The PDF shows the overall OTJ or GLH time since the last download at the top and lists each new learning record underneath
Standards use OTJ and NVQ courses use GLH automatically, and included learning records are marked only after the pack is downloaded
No other Evia behaviour, evidence PDFs, signatures, navigation or qualification mapping was changed
summary: Evia v156 adds the new OTJ/GLH learning log to evidence-pack downloads.
